name: savvy-progress
description: Progress bar above the prompt for /savvy-flow, plus an agents panel (/agents-info): running, finished and planned subagents with model, task progress, context, cost and time.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, fr, ru or he (Hebrew, drawn right to left)

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: always (default): whenever a subagent starts and the panel is closed; savvy: once per flow when a savvy-flow worker starts or a plan is reported; any: once per flow for any subagent

stepReports.title: Worker step reports
stepReports.description: off (default): the panel follows each agent's real tool calls, at no token cost; on: also ask workers to report their own steps (costs tokens)

narrator.title: Haiku narrator
narrator.description: selected (default): one short sentence on what the agent open in detail is doing, from a tiny Haiku call (~$0.0001 each); all: for every agent; off: none, the panel then costs no tokens at all
